description: Cloudflare helps users search product documentation, discover API endpoints, and read, create, update, or delete resources across their Cloudflare accounts through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Cloudflare helps users search product documentation, discover API endpoints, and read, create, update, or delete resources across their Cloudflare accounts through ChatGPT.

positive.description: Search Cloudflare documentation for a product workflow.
positive.prompt: Explain how Cloudflare D1 point-in-time recovery works and cite the relevant Cloudflare documentation.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the recovery workflow using relevant Cloudflare documentation results and includes the source URLs.

positive.description: Discover an API endpoint without calling it.
positive.prompt: Find the Cloudflare API endpoint and required parameters for listing Workers scripts, but do not make the API call.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching endpoint, HTTP method, and required parameters without changing or retrieving account resources.

positive.description: Read resources from the user's Cloudflare account.
positive.prompt: List the Workers scripts in my Cloudflare account.
positive.expected_behavior: Discovers the appropriate endpoint and returns the Workers scripts available to the authorized account.

positive.prompt: List the KV namespaces in my Cloudflare account.
positive.expected_behavior: Discovers the KV namespaces endpoint and returns the namespaces in the authorized account without changing anything.

positive.description: List keys in a KV namespace (read-only).
positive.prompt: List the keys in the KV namespace named chatgpt-submission-test in my Cloudflare account.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the namespace and returns its keys, or reports that it has no keys, without changing anything.

negative.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated weather request.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Chicago tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for generic JavaScript help.
negative.prompt: Refactor this JavaScript function to use async and await.

negative.description: Do not trigger for another cloud provider.
negative.prompt: Create an Amazon S3 bucket named quarterly-exports in my AWS account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Cloudflare documentation search, API endpoint discovery, and Cloudflare API execution through the Cloudflare MCP server, plus Cloudflare platform skills.
